prompt_sections: Difficulty control is a first-class contract. Keep target, projection, validator, assessment, and calibration aligned.
Do not make the item harder by breaking legality or truth; adjust by axis intensity, distractor competition, and context dependency.
When the requested band is missed, preserve the structure truth and surface the drift for calibration rather than hiding it.
